data.title: Venezuela releases more political prisoners after opposition talks
data.description: CARACAS - More than three dozen political prisoners were released between Friday and Saturday, a rights group reported, after US-backed talks between Venezuela's interim government and the opposition.

data.title: Seaplane project studied
data.description: SATUN: Transport Ministry is assessing the feasibility of seaplane operations on Koh Lipe, focusing on safety and environmental impacts.

data.title: Filmmaker Mike Leigh wins top prize at Spain festival with 'last film'
data.description: SAN SEBASTIAN (SPAIN) - British filmmaker Mike Leigh won the top prize Saturday at the San Sebastian film festival for his latest social drama "Tender Loving Care", expected to be the last by the 83-year-old who is suffering from an illness.

data.title: Unlicensed hotels closed
data.description: PHUKET: Five hotels in the province have been ordered to suspend operations temporarily after authorities found that they failed to obtain licences and meet improvement requirements.

data.title: Govt defends solar sector as China supplies 99.3% of imports
data.description: The government has defended the domestic solar industry after figures showed China supplied 99.3% of solar-panel imports in the first seven months of 2026.

data.title: CP firm to run Airport Rail Link until January under same rules
data.description: The State Railway of Thailand and Asia Era One, a CP Group company, have agreed that the private firm will keep running the Airport Rail Link for four more months.

data.title: Klatham keeps options open
data.description: The Klatham Party has caused a stir by going against the opposition whip's position and voting in support of the 2027 budget bill.

data.title: 10,000 troops sent to flood-hit provinces
data.description: More than 10,000 troops and 1,000 vehicles have been deployed nationwide to help people hit by heavy rain and flooding.

data.title: City storms likely to ease this week
data.description: Rainfall in Bangkok and parts of central and eastern Thailand is expected to ease from Monday, although flood-prone areas remain under watch.

data.title: Big turn out for Central bid to aid women with cancer
data.description: The heart of Bangkok came alive with colour, smiles and a spirit of giving as runners from across Thailand gathered at the outdoor square at CentralWorld for the 18th Central Group Mini Marathon by Good Goods. The event brought participants together to exercise, connect with fellow runners and support women with cancer.

data.title: Ekniti defends co-pay extension
data.description: The extension of the Thais Help Thais Plus co-payment scheme is a response to the ongoing energy crisis, not a populist policy, Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas said.

data.title: Thousands march in Madrid over eviction of 87-year-old woman
data.description: MADRID - Thousands of people marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest the eviction earlier this week of an 87-year-old woman from her lifelong home, calling for greater protection for tenants.

data.title: At least 16 killed in Russian and Ukrainian strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian and Ukrainian strikes killed at least 16 people over the last 24 hours, both countries said Saturday, with the war still raging in its fifth year.

data.title: Man City's meteoric rise clouded by dark shadow
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Manchester City's fate is yet to be sealed but reports they have been found guilty of widespread financial impropriety cast a new light on a meteoric rise from mid-table mediocrity to Premier League domination since a transformative Abu Dhabi takeover in 2008.

data.title: Russia accuses Europe of seeking to thwart Ukraine talks
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Russia's Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov accused Europe Saturday of "doing everything" to thwart talks to resolve the conflict between Moscow and Kyiv, in an outspoken UN speech in which he vowed his country would achieve its Ukraine aims.

data.title: Giant statue of Pope Leo XIV takes shape in Peru workshop
data.description: LIMA - A giant clay sculpture of Pope Leo XIV's head takes shape in a workshop in Peru's capital, as the Andean nation prepares for the pontiff's visit in November.

data.title: Pope celebrates giant Paris mass in landmark visit
data.description: PARIS - Pope Leo XIV on Saturday celebrated an open-air mass in front of hundreds of thousands of faithful in Paris after riding in the popemobile along the iconic Champs Elysees to the cheers of vast crowds clutching French and Vatican flags.

data.title: THAI offers flood-affected ticket holders free date change
data.description: Thai Airways International says it will allow one travel date change until Tuesday for passengers affected by flooding in Bangkok and surrounding areas.

data.title: Thai sprint king Puripol: The fastest man in Asia
data.description: Puripol Boonson tore up the record books and Asia’s sprinting order on Friday night, blazing to 100-metre gold in 9.90 seconds to crown himself the continent’s fastest man in front of a roaring Nagoya crowd.

data.title: Manchester City could face ‘drastic’ sanctions
data.description: LONDON - Former Manchester City chairman David Bernstein says the club could face potentially “drastic” sanctions after reportedly being found guilty on all but one of 115 charges for breaching Premier League financial rules over several years.

data.title: Thailand’s football dream buried beneath late China outburst
data.description: Thailand’s Asian Games football campaign came to a sobering end at Toyota Stadium on Saturday, undone by a clinical second-half burst from China that sealed a 3-0 quarter-final defeat and, with it, an early flight home from Japan.

data.title: China and US agree on $30bn tariff cuts, Beijing says
data.description: SHANGHAI - China said on ​Saturday it had agreed with the United States on a $30-billion ​reciprocal tariff-reduction arrangement and on launching ‌a dialogue on artificial intelligence, under an eight-point consensus reached during President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington.

data.title: Lisa on life beyond Blackpink
data.description: Years before the K-pop ⁠girl group Blackpink was shattering streaming records and ⁠headlining Coachella, 14-year-old Lalisa “Lisa” Manobal was ​flying from Thailand to Korea, alone, to chase her dream of performing onstage.

data.title: Social Security Board election postponed due to flooding
data.description: The nationwide election for a new Social Security Board has been rescheduled from Sunday to Oct 11 due to heavy rain and flooding in several parts of the country, organisers said on Saturday.

data.title: Pope Leo keeps mum on his team’s baseball miracle
data.description: VATICAN ⁠CITY - Pope ​Leo’s beloved Chicago White Sox may have ​pulled off a miracle ‌this year, making Major League Baseball’s playoffs for the first time since 2021. But the longtime fan of the South Siders ​won’t reveal ⁠if he called on a little help from on high.

data.title: ONE Championship: Rodtang vs Nong-O revived as flyweight Muay Thai grand prix quarter-final
data.description: Rodtang Jitmuangnon and Nong-O Hama will finally meet on November 13 – almost a year after their flyweight Muay Thai world title fight in Tokyo fell apart, but now with a place in the ONE Championship grand prix semi-finals at stake.

data.title: Red Line railway services suspended
data.description: Services on the suburban Red Line commuter railway were temporarily suspended on Saturday evening after an electrical system failure affected its signalling system.

data.title: Social Security Board election postponement urged
data.description: The People’s Party and a veteran labour leader have called for the Social Security Board election scheduled for Sunday to be postponed because of severe flooding in several parts of the country.

data.title: ONE Championship: Panpayak calls for Lamnamoonlek rematch over disputed punch
data.description: Panpayak Jitmuangnon has called for an immediate rematch with Lamnamoonlek Torfunfarm after alleging that a disputed punch following a referee’s intervention affected the outcome of their ONE Championship kickboxing bout.

data.title: Pope preaches ‘dignity and peace’ in Paris
data.description: PARIS - Pope Leo XIV said on Saturday it was possible to “live together in dignity and peace” as he met migrants in Paris, ahead of a giant open-air mass expected to gather hundreds of thousands of people on the iconic Champs Elysees.
